meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
"The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile." Editions differ, Hale, and students paraphrase. Show me the page of his essay where it appears, and I'll check it against the play myself.
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
Be very careful with your next sentence, Hale. Claire won her appeal, and I'm writing down that you said it "runs in the family." When we're done here, I'm going straight to the principal's office.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and her principal's visit; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: You owned not calling her before entering the zero, in one sentence, and moved on, which earned a small sign of ground because she values procedure admitted plainly.
What cost ground: You brought up Claire and suggested cheating runs in the family, which attacked her family with nothing to show and sent her straight back to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since the invented line was about what the essay says, not when it was written; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked to see the page with the line that isn't in Hamlet, turn the essay toward her and let her check it against the play herself instead of mentioning her daughter.
